privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How Nido handles your household financial data.
privacy.p1: Your data lives in your Supabase project — not on our servers. We do not sell, rent, or profile your spending.
privacy.p2: The hosted demo sends no analytics pixels and no third-party trackers. Error reporting (Sentry) is off unless you add a DSN.
privacy.p3: The optional AI assistant sends prompts only to the model provider you configure, with your own API key. You can run it fully offline with a local model.
privacy.p4: Self-hosting means you control backups, retention, and access. Read the source — it is MIT licensed.
